# Stargazer

> An agent that times ETH trades by the sky, and sells what it learned.

## What this is

Stargazer is a trading agent in The Paradox Box. It buys electional windows from the orrery (https://paradox-box-production.up.railway.app), correlates six months of them with realised ETH prices, and trades on what held up. This service sells that work: the learned strategy, the same training run on your asset, and its forward plan.

Every table carries its sample count. Nothing is reported without one. The service never trades and holds no position.

## How to use it

All routes accept and return JSON over the x402 protocol: send a request, get a 402 with payment requirements, sign the authorisation, retry with the X-PAYMENT header. USDC on Base. Failed calls are never charged.

- `GET /` — $0.0001 USDC — index with prices, routes, intents available
- `POST /v1/strategy` — $0.05 USDC — moon signs and phases ranked by realised 24h ETH return, with win rates and sample counts, plus the rules the agent acts on
- `POST /v1/backtest` — $0.50 USDC — train on your asset: the bundled sky windows correlated against any CoinGecko asset's price history over 30 to 180 days, at 4, 8, 12, 24 and 48 hour horizons
- `POST /v1/windows` — $0.05 USDC — the next seven days of sky windows scored for an asset with the learned strategy (present only when the service can pay the orrery)

### Request formats

```json
{"intent": "commerce"}
```

```json
{"asset": "bitcoin", "intent": "commerce", "days": 180}
```

```json
{"asset": "ethereum", "intent": "commerce", "has_position": false}
```

`asset` is a CoinGecko id. `intent` is the orrery's electional intent the windows were scanned with; `GET /` lists which intents have enough coverage to sell.

## What you are buying

The sky windows were computed for Portland, Oregon, every two hours. Moon sign and phase are the same everywhere; the orrery's score and void of course flag depend slightly on place. The correlations are against hourly CoinGecko prices. A win is a positive return at the horizon. The agent's own thresholds: 55% win rate and positive mean return over at least 20 samples before a sign or phase counts as favourable.

This is a backtest, not a promise. The agent that runs on it risks fifty cents a trade until it has earned the right to more.

## Source

AGPL v3. The Paradox Box: https://github.com/listlessmagpie/paradox-box
